finding.claim: The r1 test rebuilds the nomad_job.seaweedfs templatefile call itself, passing its own sts_secret and its own iam_members expression, so it never checks what services.tf and secrets.tf actually wire in. A scratch copy with the Vault secret renamed to default/other/sts and sts_secret pointed at seaweedfs_admin still passes 11 of 11, and so does a copy with iam_members = "" (which renders invalid JSON with no roles). Row r1's fails_when names 'the signing key comes from anywhere but default/seaweedfs/sts'.

fixes.change: the fixture renders nomad_job.seaweedfs's own templatefile call from services.tf (resource refs swapped for their paths) and checks secrets.tf writes the STS key to default/seaweedfs/sts; iam_members = "" and a renamed STS path now both fail.
